KABULI LAW · MISSISSAUGA

Behind every legal matter is a person, a family, or a business making an important decision.

Kabuli Law Professional Corporation is based in Mississauga, Ontario. Our practice brings together real estate, wills and estates, family law, and business law: the areas that often meet at life’s most meaningful turning points.

Whether you are preparing for a move, planning for loved ones, or considering a business decision, begin with a conversation about your circumstances and what matters to you.

06 / HELPFUL ANSWERS

A clearer
starting point.

A few practical answers
before your first conversation.

What legal services does Kabuli Law offer?

The firm's practice includes real estate, wills and estates, family law, and business law. Select an area above to explore questions you may wish to discuss.

Where is the office located?

Kabuli Law is located at Unit 24, 7895 Tranmere Drive, Mississauga, Ontario L5S 1V9. Confirm your appointment arrangements before visiting.

What should I prepare for an initial discussion?

Prepare a short overview of your situation, any relevant dates, and documents related to your matter. Ask the office what identification and additional paperwork will be needed.

How can I find out about fees?

Ask the office about the scope of the proposed work, the fee structure, and any additional expenses. Costs and timing depend on your particular matter.

Does using this website create a lawyer–client relationship?

No. This website provides general information. A lawyer–client relationship requires an agreement with the firm. Do not rely on website content as advice about your individual circumstances.
